limitations: Only the continuity relationship is described; effects and spell resolution remain unsupported.
No characteristics evaluation, controller reassignment, or stack behavior is implemented.
rules.paraphrase: Qualifying spell- or ability-generated changes to a permanent spell's characteristics or control remain applicable to the permanent produced by that spell.
rules.topic: Effect continuity from a permanent spell to its permanent

limitations: Rule 611.3d remains unresolved and unprojected.
Static abilities, continuous effects, layers, and granted abilities remain unsupported.
rules.paraphrase: A qualifying static-ability effect granting a battlefield-functional ability to a permanent spell also applies to the resulting permanent.

limitations: Prevention, damage, spell resolution, and source continuity have no runtime implementation.
No numbered damage or prevention dependency is inferred from this semantic boundary.
rules.paraphrase: Qualifying prevention attached to damage from a permanent spell also covers damage from the permanent produced by that spell.
rules.topic: Prevention continuity for a permanent spell's damage

limitations: Historical access does not make the permanent identical to the prior spell object.
No casting, mana, cost, resolution, Card-ability, or historical-query execution is implemented.
rules.paraphrase: A permanent's ability may consult casting history of the spell that produced it, including paid costs and mana used for those payments.
rules.topic: Historical spell information accessible to a permanent's ability

limitations: Findability is constrained to the relevant zone-change event and public destination.
Trigger detection, trigger processing, object tracking, and hidden-zone lookup remain unsupported.
rules.paraphrase: A qualifying zone-change triggered ability may locate the resulting object in the move's public destination associated with its triggering event.
rules.topic: Public-destination findability for a zone-change trigger

limitations: Rule 704.5m remains unresolved and unprojected.
No Aura attachment, departure trigger, simultaneous movement, state action, or tracking is implemented.
rules.paraphrase: A qualifying departure trigger can locate new Aura objects in their owners' graveyards when the Auras leave with the enchanted permanent or subsequently move there through the specified unattached-Aura state action.
rules.topic: Aura lookup after an enchanted permanent leaves

limitations: This describes continuation of the granted ability, separately from other-effect-part lookup.
No casting, permissions, stack movement, or Card semantics are implemented.
rules.paraphrase: When an effect grants a nonland card a casting ability and the card is cast through it, that granted ability remains applicable to the resulting stack object.
rules.topic: Granted casting ability continues on the resulting stack object

limitations: Other portions finding the object is a distinct relationship from granted-ability continuation.
No casting, effect execution, permissions, or stack processing is implemented.
rules.paraphrase: After a nonland card is cast through an effect's permission, the effect's other portions may locate the new stack object created by that casting.
rules.topic: Other portions of a casting-permission effect locate the stack object

limitations: Playing a land is distinct from casting a spell.
Land play, permissions, battlefield entry, and turn timing remain unsupported.
rules.paraphrase: After a land card is played through an effect's permission, the effect's other portions may locate the resulting battlefield object.
rules.topic: Other portions of a land-play permission effect locate the land

limitations: Effect-caused movement and spell-or-ability-cost-caused movement remain separate cases.
The broad tracking description does not establish semantic closure or implement effects, costs, movement, or history.
rules.paraphrase: For an effect-caused public-zone move, the effect's other portions may locate the object. For a move caused by a spell or ability cost, that spell or ability's effects may locate it.
rules.topic: Public-zone lookup after movement caused by an effect or a cost

limitations: Rule 702.35 remains unresolved and unprojected; madness is an unsupported keyword subsystem.
No madness, discard, exile handling, casting, or triggered-ability execution is implemented.
rules.paraphrase: After the madness trigger resolves without casting the exiled card, references to the discarded card may locate its resulting object if it moved into a public zone.
rules.topic: Madness-specific lookup after the card was not cast

limitations: Rule 123.5 remains unresolved and unprojected.
Sticker retention and sticker-effect continuation are distinct from general object identity.
No stickers, tickets, name or ability stickers, or continuous effects are implemented.
rules.paraphrase: Movement between public zones retains an object's stickers, and sticker effects remain applicable to the new object produced by that movement.
rules.topic: Sticker retention and effect continuity between public zones
